interfaces.name: Navigate
interfaces.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
interfaces.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
interfaces.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Rest
interfaces.function: Recover available physical energy at the current position.
interfaces.effects: Base recovery 4, modified by actually accessible registered facilities; capped at 40.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Examine an opened food sample
interfaces.function: Open and inspect an actual owned sample for internal physical deterioration and tissue condition without ingestion. Safety, calories and toxin absence remain unknown.
interfaces.costs: Two performed work rounds, 0.5 energy each, and 0.1 food unit temporarily escrowed and retained as opened material. Hard samples require one actual owned hard stone tool, retained. No health, nutrition or detoxification benefit.
interfaces.effects: Measured internal condition with explicit uncertainty and conserved provenance. No repeated-finding reward. Existing authored paid-practice milestones remain distinct from the shared confirmed-understanding source.

execution.progress: Two performed work stages. Global pauses preserve exact work; a missing retained tool pauses without charges. Action change, movement or death cancels and releases surviving opened material once. Spent energy is not refunded.

A tray uses 0.4 bark over 2 work rounds at 0.5 energy/round. These are proposed products, not existing equipment. Comparison weights are actual retained stone pieces, made by paid subdivision with an owned hard stone tool: 2 rounds and 1 energy/round per batch, with fragments and waste conserving mass. Use relative comparison masses, not privileged item-mass readouts; record resolution, repeatability and calibration history. Without a traceable external standard, report mass ratios and uncertainty, not absolute certified grams.\\nDry-mass method: escrow at least 0.1 owned food unit; obtain an initial balance reading, spread the same sample on the tray, then perform repeated drying and weighing. Initial preparation and each weighing cost one round and 0.5 energy. Drying advances each round from actual ambient temperature, humidity, sample surface area and moisture, with evaporated water transferred to the environmental water ledger. Implement the necessary moisture/thermal coupling; passive drying cannot remove nonvolatile solids or create nutrition. Use existing food moisture as model initialization, not as an observation returned directly to the actor. Keep food decay and contamination active. Completion requires three consecutive paid readings separated by actual drying intervals, stable within the calibrated balance resolution; otherwise report incomplete drying. Report observed mass loss and residual fraction with uncertainty and possible volatile-loss/contamination confounds. Do not call residual mass calories, digestible carbohydrate, protein or toxin absence. Return the actual altered residue with original nutrient and toxin totals conserved except for explicitly modeled real losses, and trace every loss to an output stream. The residue remains available to existing eating mechanics with its altered moisture and provenance; analysis itself supplies no nutrition.\\nChemical-screen dependency contract: protein-precipitation requires actual clean vessels, measured solvent, a verified soluble-protein reagent, a characterized tannin reference, reagent blank and negative control, plus calibrated mass/volume or optical comparison equipment. No catalogue resource or appearance alone certifies these. Do not create reagents, references, water stock or an acquisition accomplishment during implementation. Until these dependencies have real production/acquisition and verification records, this mode returns missing prerequisites before reserving sample or charging work. Once satisfied, execute matched blank, negative, positive-reference and sample extractions at recorded concentrations, consuming 0.1 sample unit and actual allocated reagent/solvent quantities; 6 active rounds at 0.5 energy/round plus measured settling time. Record all extracts and waste. Report only protein-precipitating activity relative to the reference: this is a tannin-compatible hazard screen, not toxin identification. Detection limit is the lowest independently prepared reference dilution distinguished from blanks by the implemented measurement model; failed controls invalidate the run. No microbial, alkaloid or universal-safety claim follows from a negative result. Broader nutritional or hazard claims remain unmeasured.\\nPersistent state includes owner, sample lineage, apparatus IDs and calibration, allocated materials, readings, environmental history, assay stage, paid effort, actual remaining work, residues and waste. Place equipment in shared world geometry on unobstructed ground; apply actual footprint/collision and support constraints. Active handling requires distance <=0.65 from its interaction boundary; unattended passive drying follows real local conditions and remains physically accessible to interference. No room-wide drying, shade or insulation effects are implied. Global pauses freeze progress. Missing equipment, unsuitable weather or inadequate energy pauses without charging unperformed work. Movement/action change cancels active handling; explicit cancellation or death terminates that actor's multi-round operation and releases surviving escrow exactly once at the apparatus or valid ground position. Preserve altered material, spent work and losses; never restore the original sample or clone escrow. No automatic continuation after death.\\nDeclare food-assay-started, assay-reading, food-assay-completed and assay-invalidated; also emit existing process-progress, process-stopped, trial-result and information-confirmed where appropriate. Events carry actor, project, apparatus, sample lineage, method, controls, uncertainty, paid costs, remaining work and output IDs. Register subscriptions before emitting events. Migrate additively: existing samples retain their opening/decay history; old observations remain limited observations, not assay results. Implementation advances no simulation time and grants neither equipment nor mastery.\",\n      \"experienceReview\": \"A successfully completed measurement establishing a genuinely new, supported observation can plausibly provide the existing confirmed-understanding experience. Subscribe food-assay's information-confirmed event to grounded-understanding, qualified only for the performing actor with completed paid measurements, valid calibration/controls, explicit uncertainty and a previously unverified finding. Reuse its 0.8 amount, cap 1, duration 8 rounds, refresh repetition and 12-round cooldown; maintained participation adds 0.035 within that same source's bounded saturation, with existing 0.0015 decay. Do not add an assay-specific duplicate source. Repeated measurements may improve evidence, but identical established findings do not qualify as new information. Application, equipment labels, learning, invalid runs and merely discovering missing prerequisites award nothing. No separate pleasure or mastery reward is established; health, hunger and toxin exposure remain governed by actual physical events.\",\n      \"visualReview\": \"Render the constructed balance, its pans and allocated loads, drying tray and changing sample as persistent objects at their real positions. Show active handling only during paid work and show passive moisture loss only when the physical process advances. Replay assay-reading events as measured comparisons with resolution and uncertainty; completion displays residue, losses, controls and unresolved hazards, never a generic safe-food badge. Invalid or interrupted runs visibly preserve their actual partial samples and remaining-work record. Chemical-screen graphics appear only after real reagents and equipment have been supplied and used.\",\n      \"learning\": 5\n    }\n  ]\n}","logprobs":[]}
